properties.name: REGISTRY-SYNC
properties.evidence: forge invariant_registrySync (256 runs / 128k calls, 0 reverts) + medusa property_registrySync (100k calls). isRegisteredStrategy[s] <=> in array <=> strategyTokens[s]!=0 held under add/remove churn on 3 spare strategies; no duplicates ever observed.

properties.name: SPLIT-CONSERVATION
properties.evidence: forge invariant_splitConservation + invariant_globalConservation and medusa property_splitConservation/property_globalConservation all green across the full nudgeSplit [0,100] range and discount [0,50%]. nudgeAmount + phlimboAmount == actualPayment exactly; aggregate paid == nudge + phlimbo.

properties.name: DECIMAL-ROUNDTRIP
properties.evidence: forge testFuzz_DecimalRoundtrip (256 runs over decimals 0..18, rate 0..1e20, x 0..1e27): denormalize(normalize(x))<=x always (never over-charges); exact when rate in {0,1e18}. test_Roundtrip_SubUnitFloorsToZero pins the L-01 boundary: 5e11 (half a 6-dec reward unit) -> 0, 1e12 -> 1.

properties.name: PAYMENT-FLOOR / ZERO-PAYMENT-WITH-YIELD DRAIN
properties.severityHint: potential-high / confirms Medium CODE-001 + ECON-01 and Low L-01
properties.evidence: test_DecimalDrain_UnconfiguredStrategyToken_ZeroPayment PASSES asserting the buggy behavior: with a 6-dec strategy token left UNCONFIGURED (tokenConfigs == (0,0)) and the 6-dec reward token configured, a claim delivered 1,000,000,000 (1000 tokens, 6-dec) of real yield to the claimer while actualPayment == 0 and phlimbo received 0. calculateClaimAmount() previewed 0 as well, so the loss is silent. Control test (token configured) charges the full 1000e6 -> proves the gap is the missing setTokenConfig, not the amount. test_ZeroFloor_TinyYield_ConfiguredTokens additionally shows the pure L-01 floor: 1e11 wei of an 18-dec token claimed for free even when everything is configured.
properties.rootCause: _normalizeAmount/_denormalizeAmount treat an unconfigured token (decimals==0 && rate==0) as 18-dec 1:1; an unconfigured <18-dec strategy token is under-normalized by 10**(18-d), and after the 18->reward-dec denormalize the payment floors to 0 (no minimum-payment / zero-floor re-guard; minRewardTokenSupplied defaults to 0).

properties.name: NFT-COST
properties.evidence: forge invariant_nftCostExactlyOne + medusa property_nftCostExactlyOne: every successful claim burns exactly 1 ERC1155 unit. Deterministic test_NoNFTBurnOnRevert confirms a ZeroAmount-reverting claim consumes no NFT (atomic); test_ExactlyOneNFTBurnedOnSuccess confirms the single-burn on success.

properties.name: NO-RESIDUAL
properties.evidence: forge invariant_noResidual + medusa property_noResidual: accumulator reward-token balance and both strategy-token balances are 0 after every claim across 128k forge calls and 100k medusa calls. skimSurplus delivers underlying straight to the claimer; reward in == nudge out + phlimbo pull out.

failures.invariant: PAYMENT-FLOOR (property 4) — demonstrated as a passing PoC asserting the defect, not a failing assertion

counterexample.setup: rewardToken=USDC(6-dec) configured (6,1e18); strategy registered with a 6-dec underlying token left UNCONFIGURED; discount=0; minRewardTokenSupplied=0
counterexample.result: claimer receives 1000e6 (1000) tok6 of real yield; actualPayment == 0; phlimbo receives 0; preview also returned 0

failures.note: This is the value-extraction drain. Surfaced by Tier-2 as Medium (CODE-001/ECON-01) gated on an owner config omission (a non-obvious footgun, in scope under Law 3) plus the structural L-01 zero-floor. Use this test as the PoC basis; severity to be set by severity-classifier.

notes: All structural invariants (registry sync, split & global conservation, decimal round-trip bound, NFT cost, no residual) HOLD under both forge (256 runs) and medusa (100k calls, 8 workers) with zero reverts/failures.

The single broken property (4) is the intended target: it confirms CODE-001/ECON-01 (decimal-config drain) and ledger L-01 (zero-payment floor). It is encoded as a deterministic passing PoC that asserts payment==0 while yield>0, so it doubles as the runnable proof-of-concept.
Workspace is buildable at commit 71abe3e; forge build clean. Medusa 1.5.1 used as the stateful fuzzer (Echidna not installed).
